events.title: Interparfums Q1 Earnings Top Estimates on Coach-Led Brand Gains
events.body: IPAR posts record Q1 2026 results as EPS and sales rise, beating consensus, with Coach up 30%, helping offset softer regions.

events.title: Revolve Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Active Customers Grow 8% Y/Y
events.body: RVLV beats Q1 earnings estimates as sales jump 16% y/y and margins expand, driven by strong segment growth, rising demand and improved FWRD profitability.

events.title: SN Q1 Earnings Beat on Broad Category Strength, 2026 Outlook Raised
events.body: SharkNinja tops Q1 earnings estimates and raises its 2026 outlook as international expansion and product innovation continue to drive growth.

events.title: Revolve Group (RVLV) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
events.body: Revolve Group (RVLV) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +9.77% and +4.11%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
